mapper.insert: insert into account_idempotency_records (id, idempotency_key, operator_id, request_method, request_path, request_hash, status, response_status, response_body, created_at, expires_at) values (#{record.id}, #{record.idempotencyKey}, #{record.operatorId}, #{record.requestMethod}, #{record.requestPath}, #{record.requestHash}, #{record.status}, #{record.responseStatus}, #{record.responseBody}, #{record.createdAt}, #{record.expiresAt})
mapper.update: update account_idempotency_records set status = 'completed', response_status = #{responseStatus}, response_body = #{responseBody}, expires_at = #{expiresAt} where id = #{id} and status = 'processing'
